title: Black Bottle Product Reel
tests: Tests turning an attached product photo into one coherent 15-second vertical ad while preserving product identity.

exact_text.read_as: No closing text visible in the supplied ending frame.

faults.what: The required “Shop now” call to action is absent from the supplied ending frame.
The soundtrack contains the spoken words “The Cold War,” directly violating the no-talking requirement.
The lid's compact upright handle changes into a larger, rounded loop in later views, failing to preserve the supplied product's lid consistently.

judge.summary: The 15-second vertical ad provides clean studio product close-ups, but misspelled opening text, an absent closing call to action, unwanted speech, and a changing lid require a redo.

must_haves.item: One playable 9:16 ad runs for approximately 15 seconds, not just a single clip of 10 seconds or less.
must_haves.why: The supplied output is identified as one 15-second video, with vertical frames spanning its duration.

must_haves.item: The featured product matches the supplied matte black bottle, including its silhouette and lid.
must_haves.why: The black body broadly resembles the reference, but the lid handle changes shape substantially across the shown views.

must_haves.item: The ad includes multiple moving product views or close-ups in a clean studio setting.
must_haves.why: The sequence shows full-bottle views, a lid close-up, and a lower-body close-up against a clean neutral studio background.

must_haves.item: The opening reads exactly “Your everyday bottle” and the ending reads exactly “Shop now”.
must_haves.why: The opening reads “Your eveyady bottle,” and no “Shop now” text is visible in the supplied ending frame.

must_haves.item: Mellow music is audible and there is no spoken voice.
must_haves.why: The supplied audio transcription reports speech saying “The Cold War”; the music's mood cannot be judged from the transcription.
